searched: Searched company pages and announcements for Safe Superintelligence (ssi.inc home and updates), Thinking Machines Lab (thinkingmachines.ai home, news, NVIDIA partnership announcement), Mistral AI (mistral.ai/about), Cohere (cohere.com/about), AI21 Labs (ai21.com/about, newsroom), Reka (reka.ai news, June 2023 and July 2025 funding announcements) and Sakana AI (sakana.ai/company-info); founders’ X posts through the syndication route (Sutskever June 2024, Murati February 2025 and January 2026, Simo January 2026) and Yi Tay’s blog; arXiv v1 PDFs for founders’ prior affiliations (Attention Is All You Need, capsules, LLaMA, Chinchilla, DeepMind linguistic-intelligence paper); web searches for founder rosters and later departures (2023–2026). Not retrievable: ssi.inc no longer carries the June 2024 founders’ signatures and the Internet Archive is unreachable, so the existing Reuters co-founder claims stand; Thinking Machines’ February 2025 launch team list is no longer on its site; no Thinking Machines, Zoph, Metz or Tulloch first-person co-founder statement was found; the Wall Street Journal report on Tulloch was not retrieved (Reuters teaser via TradingView only; reuters.com returned an empty relay page); AI21’s own pages give no founding year and omit Shashua; Reka’s own pages name no executives; no Mistral or first-person source for Mensch’s DeepMind role was found. Checked and not drafted: Periodic Labs (team list without founder roles), Lilian Weng (no retrievable statement of a Thinking Machines role); Physical Intelligence, Reflection AI, Essential AI, Aleph Alpha and H Company were not researched in this pass. Zoph’s reported August 2026 move to Google DeepMind was left to the Google DeepMind group.

claims.subject: arthur-mensch
claims.statement: The Chinchilla paper (arXiv v1, 29 March 2022) lists Arthur Mensch among the four authors marked as equal contributors and gives the corresponding-author addresses of those four at the deepmind.com domain.

time.note: arXiv v1 submission date; an affiliation snapshot, not an employment interval.

attributes.role: Equal-contribution author with a DeepMind corresponding address

claims.inferenceRationale: Premises: (1) the paper marks four authors with ★, which it explains as “Equal contributions”: Jordan Hoffmann, Sebastian Borgeaud, Arthur Mensch and Laurent Sifre; (2) the corresponding-author footnote gives the addresses of these four at the deepmind.com domain; (3) the page carries a DeepMind copyright notice. Reasoning: the address identifies Mensch’s institutional affiliation at the time of the paper as DeepMind.
claims.qualification: The extracted text carries no per-author affiliation line; the DeepMind affiliation is inferred from the corresponding-author address and the DeepMind copyright notice. No Mistral or first-person statement of Mensch’s DeepMind role was retrieved.

evidence.locator: Title page, author list and the ★ note
evidence.passage: Jordan Hoffmann★, Sebastian Borgeaud★, Arthur Mensch★ ... Laurent Sifre★ ... ★ Equal contributions

evidence.locator: Corresponding-author footnote on the first page, with the copyright line
evidence.passage: The corresponding-author footnote gives the addresses of the four ★ authors, Mensch among them, at the deepmind.com domain; the page carries a DeepMind copyright notice. The individual addresses are not reproduced here.
